name: Raman spectra of binary mixtures of the anhydrous (NAn) and monohydrate-A (NHa) forms of niclosamide: NHa %w/w quantification (Valmala et al. 2019, Talanta 199, 679-688)
description: Raman spectra of 57 binary mixtures of the anhydrous (NAn) and metastable monohydrate-A (NHa) forms of the anthelmintic drug niclosamide, from the supplementary workbook of Valmala et al. 2019 (Talanta 199, 679-688, doi:10.1016/j.talanta.2019.03.027; Mendeley Data doi:10.17632/mv686f9r66.1, CC BY-NC 3.0; the workbook's other sheets cover NIR and MIR and are not loaded). Task: single-target regression - the Y variable is 'Concentration of NHa (%w/w)' (0-100). Levels: the calibration block has 6 spectra each at 0, 10, 30, 50, 70, 90 and 100 %, plus the authors' validation block (20% x3 and 50% x3 'Accuracy', 80% x3 'Accuracy' + 80% x6 'Precision') - 9 distinct levels, 57 spectra total. The sheet's remaining blocks are not loaded: a ball-milling time course (Y = milling time 5/60/180 min, 9 spectra) and four spectra labelled by NHa:NHb ratio ('NHa: NHb (9:1)' x2, '(1:9)' x2, non-numeric Y) - they quantify NHa under processing or in the presence of the NHb monohydrate, a different experimental design. Niclosamide crystallizes into three solvated forms: NAn (anhydrous) and two monohydrates (NHa, NHb); NAn converts to NHa during high-energy milling in the presence of water, which is why NHa quantification matters. Raman region: 195 points, 1,051.093-1,799.338 cm^-1 (~3.857 cm^-1 spacing; stored descending in the workbook, flipped to ascending by the loader). The six spectra per level are the study's replicates; their preparation protocol is not documented in the SI, so is_grouped=False. Served from a frozen copy of the SI workbook 'SI- spectal Raw data.xlsx' (10,569,495 B, sha256 9d81a8d9...14ec) mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (niclosamide/): Mendeley Data 403-blocks non-browser clients (including CI).

rai:dataCollection: Raman measurements of binary NAn+NHa niclosamide form mixtures at nine NHa levels (0-100 %w/w); the workbook also records the authors' ball-milling time course and NHa-in-presence-of-NHb spectra (not loaded here).
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The loader only flips the workbook's descending wavenumber axis to ascending; no baseline correction, normalization, smoothing or resampling is applied. Intensities are as deposited (arbitrary units). The authors' PLSR modeling was done in the paper, not on the deposited data.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels are the nominal NHa %w/w of each mixture as printed in column A of the workbook (the study's calibration levels); no human labelling was performed for this benchmark. The six spectra per level are the study's replicates; whether they are independent preparations or repeated measurements of one mixture is not documented in the SI.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are pharmaceutical solid forms of niclosamide.
rai:dataBiases: Single lab/instrument protocol; the level design is uneven (6 replicates at calibration levels, 3-6 at validation levels; 20 % and 80 % exist only as validation rows); the spectra are the authors' calibration and validation samples, so any model trained on them is optimised for the study's mixture design and Raman window (1,051-1,800 cm^-1, a cropped region, not the full spectrum). The CC BY-NC 3.0 license restricts commercial use.
rai:dataLimitations: Cropped Raman window (1,051-1,800 cm^-1 only); uneven replicate counts per level (3-9); the authors' own calibration/validation split is not encoded per row (all 57 rows are pooled); the replicate preparation protocol is undocumented (is_grouped=False); the ball-milling time-course and ratio-labelled blocks are excluded (different Y semantics); intensities in arbitrary units (0.0018-10.05); CC BY-NC 3.0 (non-commercial).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Supports pharmaceutical solid-form analysis: quantifying pseudopolymorphic conversion (anhydrous to monohydrate A) of niclosamide, a drug repurposed for cancer, during wet processing; no human or medical data.
rai:dataUseCases: Single-target regression: predict the NHa (monohydrate-A) %w/w fraction of a binary NAn+NHa niclosamide mixture from its Raman spectrum in the 1,051-1,800 cm^-1 window; note the 9-level design and the authors' calibration / validation composition.
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Data collection: Raman spectra of niclosamide form mixtures recorded for the study 'Quantification of niclosamide polymorphic forms - a comparative study by Raman, NIR and MIR using chemometric techniques' (Bhavana Valmala, Rahul B. Chavan, M.K. Chaitanya Mannava, Ashwini Nangia, Nalini R. Shastri 2019, Talanta 199, 679-688, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.talanta.2019.03.027); deposited on Mendeley Data (Nalini Shastri, 2019-03-09, https://doi.org/10.17632/mv686f9r66.1, CC BY-NC 3.0) as the supplementary workbook 'SI- spectal Raw data.xlsx' (10,569,495 bytes, sha256 pinned). Niclosamide (anthelmintic drug) crystallizes into three solvated forms: the anhydrous form (NAn) and two monohydrates (NHa, NHb); NAn converts to the metastable monohydrate NHa during high-energy milling in the presence of water, which motivates quantifying the NHa fraction. Each Raman sheet of the workbook: row 4 carries the 195-point wavenumber axis (1,799.338-1,051.093 cm^-1, stored DESCENDING, ~3.857 cm^-1 spacing; flipped to ascending by the raman_data loader), then one spectrum per row with the Y label in column A ('Concentration of NHa (%w/w)'). This raman_data key loads the concentration-regression rows (calibration block: six spectra per level; plus the authors' validation block); the trailing blocks whose Y column means something else are not loaded. Mendeley Data 403-blocks non-browser clients (including CI), so the key reads a frozen copy of the workbook mirrored at HTW-KI-Werkstatt/RamanBench (niclosamide/). Sheet used: 'Raman binary' (binary NAn+NHa mixtures; 57 spectra: 42 calibration at 0/10/30/50/70/90/100 % NHa x6 plus 15 validation rows 20%x3, 50%x3, 80%x3 'Accuracy' and 80%x6 'Precision').
